selection_method.discovery: Public YouTube search through yt-dlp ytsearch results, with separate fixed queries for PokerGO, PokerStars, Triton Poker, and World Poker Tour. Video metadata only was inspected before selection; no streams were opened or downloaded before the candidate list was locked.
ordered_queries: ytsearch20:Phil Ivey Triton NLH poker (supplementary query, added after first three clips were reviewed)
eligibility: Uploader must be the official channel for one of the four named operators, checked by channel name and stable channel ID.
Public video metadata and stream must be available without an account, cookies, or access workaround.
The title and description must identify one specific hand or one pot featuring Ivey, rather than a compilation, broad session, or complete match.
Standard no-limit hold'em must be supported by the video/event metadata; explicit Short Deck and Shark Cage sources are excluded from standard NLHE scoring.
Skip the already reconstructed PokerGO video YfjDfPk7e1E and the two historical records already in the project.
selection_method.ordering: Within each fixed query, candidates were considered in search-result order. The first three PokerGO videos meeting metadata-only criteria were locked as the initial hand batch before review. To expand the requested first batch, the next eligible single-hand official-source result in the remaining fixed query order was then locked as a fourth source before its review. Do not replace a source because the observed action or outcome is inconvenient.
